monitor_daemon_interval.description: Interval in seconds between Monit checks. Minimum 5 seconds.

monitor_log_file.description: Path to the Monit log file.

mail_servers.description: SMTP servers to use for sending alert emails. At least one required for email alerts.

email_recipients.description: Email addresses to receive alerts (comma-separated in Monit config).

httpd_enabled.description: Enable the built-in HTTP server for web UI and status checks.

httpd_port.description: Port for the HTTP daemon. Required if httpd_enabled is true.

httpd_ssl.description: Enable HTTPS for the HTTP daemon.

httpd_ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate file (if HTTPS enabled).

httpd_ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (if HTTPS enabled).

httpd_allow_from.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR subnets for HTTP access.

event_queue.description: Event queue configuration for buffering alerts during downtime.

monit_opts.description: Additional command-line options to pass to the monit daemon (e.g., '-I' for init-style startup).
